countingRules.honestAbsence: Non-staged roster city with positive-evidence status NO-ZONING-AUTHORITY, NO-EUCLIDEAN-REGIME, or ORDINANCE-NO-GIS.
countingRules.authWalled: Non-staged roster city with status AUTH-WALLED.
countingRules.nfuw: Non-staged roster city with status NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY.
countingRules.noStatusOrLegacyOpen: Non-staged roster city lacking a seven-status value, including legacy lowercase searched-and-absent and never-classified rows.
countingRules.genuinelyOpenCities: totalCities - stagedCities - honestAbsence. AUTH-WALLED, HOST-BROKEN, NFUW, and no-status rows remain open.
countingRules.countyStatus: A county is not satisfied merely because one city is staged. Any genuinelyOpenCities > 0 is genuinely open. Candidate-satisfied counties still require drain+stamp+score and live ledger verification.

stagedCityRatio.rule: distinct staged city_key / roster cities in footprint

countiesWithAnyStaging.rule: counties with >=1 distinct staged city / 28 signed footprint counties

candidateCompleteAtCityInventory.rule: all roster cities are staged or positively absent; still not ledger-satisfied until drain+stamp+score

genuinelyOpenCounties.rule: county has >=1 incorporated city neither staged nor positively absent
